# Monte Carlo PPR against exact PPR (generated by tools/ppr_exact.py)

`user_time` validation stage (training part only), 2,000 sampled users with at least one like, alpha 0.3, 20 steps, top-10 unseen movies. Machine: macOS-27.0.1-arm64-arm-64bit.

Exact expected visits: 305.36 s for the sample (152.68 s per 1,000 users), NDCG@10 0.0802 without and 0.0867 with the popularity penalty (beta 0.3).

| Walkers W | Overlap@10, raw PPR | NDCG@10, raw PPR | Overlap@10, chosen rules | NDCG@10, chosen rules | Monte Carlo s per 1,000 users |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 0.5089 | 0.0644 | 0.7568 | 0.0681 | 0.48 |
| 250 | 0.6509 | 0.0721 | 0.5335 | 0.0705 | 0.55 |
| 1000 | 0.8062 | 0.0790 | 0.7294 | 0.0822 | 1.0 |
| 2500 (chosen) | 0.8732 | 0.0797 | 0.8238 | 0.0842 | 1.86 |

Raw PPR: beta 0, min_visits 1. Chosen rules: beta 0.3 on both sides, min_visits 10 on the Monte Carlo side only (it filters sampling noise, which the exact scores do not have).
